findings.rationale: HI's BMI distribution is pulled far below the federation (BMI p01 ~0.2 vs federation median ~18; mean ~14 vs median 28.9), consistent with zeros used as a missing-value sentinel. PhysHlth p99 is ~74 (sentinel-like 99-coded values inflate the upper tail; federation median p99 ~30). The signature is already present at round 1 (BMI mean 13.64). Locally the model under-predicts (CITL z=-3.5), and HI's updates are anomalous (min cos -0.61, median norm ratio 1.6). Drift is not the cause (max shift 0.22 SD).

MD's BMI p01 is about -0.08 and its mean ~14.3 (federation median mean 28.9), indicating a zero sentinel for missing BMI. PhysHlth p99 is ~74 with z_noise ~29, indicating sentinel-coded values. Present from round 1 (BMI mean 14.76, PhysHlth mean 38.2). Strongest local miscalibration in the federation (CITL z=-4.5, ECE z=+3.5), and anomalous updates (median norm ratio 1.93, min cos -0.51). The subgroup O/E excess is the same in both sexes, consistent with a global calibration problem rather than subgroup bias.

TX shows the same sentinel pattern: BMI p01 ~0.32 and mean ~14.7 (federation median 28.9), PhysHlth p99 ~73 with z_noise ~23. Present from round 1 (BMI mean 14.47, PhysHlth mean 38.9). Local CITL is strongly negative (z=-4.0) with ECE z=+3.2, and updates are anomalous (min cos -0.56, median norm ratio 1.61). Drift is not the cause.

report.summary: Three clients (HI, MD, TX) show the same missing-value sentinel signature from round 1: BMI near zero (mean ~14 vs federation median 28.9) and PhysHlth tail values near 99 (p99 ~73, z_noise 20–30). Each also has negative calibration-in-the-large, and anomalous update norms and cosines. I attribute these to missing_artefact, with onset round 1. Other leads were checked and dismissed as noise: the negative Sex means for AK, AL and GU (round-20 Sex means are normal); the drift flags for AL, NV and GU (per-round shifts are erratic with no sustained change); GU's update-norm flag (z=+3.5, small client); and the subgroup O/E excesses, which are the same across sexes and consistent with the global calibration issue. No poisoning, label_noise, prevalence_shift or explanation_instability was supported. The budget is fully spent (20.0 used).
